name: CMS
definition: Content Management System: where the client edits text, images and projects without touching code.

name: Three.js
definition: A JavaScript library for drawing 3D graphics in the browser with WebGL.

name: SVG
definition: A vector image format: sharp at any size and light to load.

name: ScrollTrigger
definition: A GSAP plugin that ties animations to the scroll position.

name: Unicorn Studio
definition: A tool for designing WebGL visual effects and embedding them in a site.

name: D3
definition: A JavaScript library for drawing data: charts, maps and diagrams.

name: TopoJSON
definition: A compact file format for map shapes, like the outline of every U.S. state.

name: AEO
definition: Answer engine optimization: shaping content so AI assistants like ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google's AI answers can understand it and cite it.

name: JSON-LD
definition: Structured data in a script tag that tells search engines and AI exactly what a page is: an article, a term, an FAQ, a business.

name: multi-reference
definition: A Webflow CMS field that links one item to many others, like an article to every topic it covers.

name: Finsweet
definition: Free Webflow add-ons for filters, sorting and CMS tricks Webflow doesn't do natively.

name: Webflow
definition: The visual builder this site runs on: real HTML and CSS, with a CMS your team can edit.

name: WebGL
definition: Your graphics card drawing in the browser. It's how the planets spin without melting your laptop.

name: GSAP
definition: The animation engine behind most of the motion here. Smooth at 60fps, polite to your battery.

name: Figma
definition: Where every page starts: design, prototypes and comments before any code.

name: Client-First
definition: A naming system for Webflow classes, so the next developer isn't lost.

name: Variables
definition: Colors, sizes and fonts saved once and reused. Change one, the whole site follows.

name: Component
definition: A reusable block: edit it once and every copy updates.

name: Lighthouse
definition: Google's speed, accessibility and SEO audit. The report card a launch has to pass.

name: API
definition: How two apps talk to each other without you copy-pasting between them.

name: Handoff
definition: The part where your team gets the keys and a guide, not a phone number.

name: Breakpoint
definition: The screen width where a layout rearranges itself for tablets and phones.

name: Lenis
definition: The smooth-scroll engine. It's why the page glides instead of jumping.

name: Rive
definition: Interactive animations that react to input, lighter than video.

name: Reduced motion
definition: A system setting some people need. This site honors it: calmer and still complete.

name: Discovery call
definition: A 30-minute chat: where you're headed, what's in the way, whether we're a fit.

name: 2 cursors online
definition: One of them is you. The other one is also you, in another tab. Probably.

name: Launch window
definition: Launch window open. Seats on this flight are limited (to one, it's just me).

name: The mark
definition: An A and a B, drawn as a planet. 25 iterations, most of them bad.

name: Caffeine log
definition: Measured in mugs, not cups. The science is settled.

name: Lines of code
definition: All hand-written. Every one of them has been rewritten at least once.

name: Not sure yet
definition: Totally fine. Most good missions start here.

name: Black hole
definition: Yes, you can feed it things. No, it won't give them back.

name: Layout grid
definition: The layout grid I design on. 12 columns, 24px gutters.

name: T-minus
definition: Six stages, one launch. The clock only starts after the discovery call.

name: REC
definition: Not actually recording. It just likes to look busy.

name: Earth
definition: Every mission starts here: your brief, your goals, your deadline.

name: Touchdown
definition: You made it. The confetti is real (as real as it gets on the internet).

name: Re-reading
definition: Thus Spoke Zarathustra. Light reading for long flights.

name: Home planet
definition: Two moons: violet for my wife, green for my son. They keep the orbit steady.

name: Signal lost
definition: Even the best navigators lose a signal. The warp drive can get you home.

name: Crew level
definition: Cadet keeps it plain English. Engineer shows the wiring. Switch anytime, no clearance needed.
